notes: §2002:15.12.2 AR1 'Argument-1 shall be an alphanumeric or national literal, a based entry, a type-name, or a data item of any class or category': every kind is written and accepted - alphanumeric literal (LIT), national literal (NLIT), type-names T-REC, G-PTR and G-OBJ (TYPE, PTR, OBJ), based entry B-REC (BASED), and data items of class/category alphanumeric, alphabetic, numeric, numeric with separate sign, numeric-edited, national, boolean display, boolean bit, pointer, index, object reference, FLOAT-LONG, a bit-bearing alphanumeric group, and the record and implicit items of 2002 input CDs ... Run at --std 2002 with the pinned build dc1f2dcce8: output equals the derivation.
